components.notes: Ungrouped options render first, then grouped options under their header. Filtering is case-insensitive on label. components.name: useToastStore (toastStore)
components.purpose: Zustand store holding the toast queue: addToast returns an id, auto-dismisses after duration, caps the queue at 3 (drops oldest). No styling in this file.
components.props:
export interface Toast { id: string; message: string; description?: string; graduationDelta?: { creditsDelta: number; categoryLabel: string; categoryPct?: { before: number; after: number }; categoryCredits?: { after: number; required: number }; secondRowLabel: string; secondRowPct: { before: number; after: number }; secondRowCredits: { after: number; required: number }; }; type: 'success' | 'info' | 'warning'; action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void }; duration?: number; }
interface ToastState { toasts: Toast[]; addToast: (toast: Omit<Toast, 'id'>) => string; removeToast: (id: string) => void; }

elements.classes: (no className) default duration = toast.duration ?? 5000 ms; max 3 toasts visible (newToasts.slice(-3)); id = crypto.randomUUID(); auto-dismiss via setTimeout -> removeToast(id)

components.notes: Type union is 'success' | 'info' | 'warning' — there is no 'error' toast type. graduationDelta carries before/after percentages and after/required credit pairs for two rows (a category row and a 'second row'), implying the Toast UI renders mini progress deltas.

oddities: Footer background bg-[#0d2654] is an off-brand hex (darker navy) not in the #153974 / #3069B3 / #00AACA trio; appears only here.
ErrorBoundary primary button hover uses hover:bg-[#003E7E], another off-brand hex; hover shade for the navy button is not derived from the trio.

ZoomableImage modal uses 'animate-in fade-in duration-200' but no tailwindcss-animate plugin is installed and globals.css only defines .animate-fade-in / -up / -down, so these are dead classes and the lightbox appears without animation.

Footer contains an empty

(tagline left blank) that still contributes mb-3 spacing.
Footer links '수강 계획' and '졸업 요건 추적' both point to /planner.
Icon source inconsistency: SearchableSelect clear button and ErrorBoundary use hand-inlined heroicons-style SVGs while ZoomableImage and Footer use lucide-react (X, ZoomIn, Mail).
Size-class order inconsistency: Footer Mail uses 'w-4 h-4' while everything else uses 'h-4 w-4'.
ErrorBoundary hand-rolls its primary button instead of reusing the Button primitive; its focus ring uses focus:ring-offset-2 while SearchableSelect's input ring has no offset.
Border-radius mix: ErrorBoundary pre uses 'rounded' (4px) while cards use rounded-lg and controls rounded-md.
One-off font size text-[11px] in the ZoomableImage mobile pill (everything else uses text-xs/text-sm).
Brand opacity variants used ad hoc: bg-[#153974]/10 (selected option tint) and bg-[#153974]/90 (desktop zoom pill).
CopyEmail is hard-coupled to a dark background (text-gray-400 -> hover:text-white) and to a personal Gmail address hard-coded twice in Footer (CopyEmail prop and mailto href).
Footer column headings are English ('Service', 'Support', 'Legal') while all links are Korean; copyright line is mixed Korean/English.

Punctuation inconsistency: ErrorBoundary body and SearchableSelect empty state end with periods, while the Footer disclaimer '이 서비스는 영남대학교 공식 서비스가 아닙니다' and most hints do not; '복사됨!' is the only exclamation.

Contrast concern: text-gray-500 (fine print, copyright, mail icon) on #0d2654 footer background is roughly 3.5:1 — below AA 4.5:1 for text-xs copy. text-white/80 on bg-black/40 over an arbitrary image may also fail depending on the underlying picture.

Accessibility: SearchableSelect has no role=combobox/listbox/option, no aria-expanded, no aria-label on the clear button, no arrow-key navigation (Escape and click-outside only). ZoomableImage thumbnail is a clickable div (not focusable), modal lacks role=dialog/aria-modal, focus trap and Escape handling. CopyEmail confirmation has no aria-live.
SearchableSelect option: hover:bg-gray-100 wins over bg-[#153974]/10 when hovering the selected option, so the selected tint disappears on hover.
ZoomableImage is a default export while the other ui/ primitives are named exports.
toastStore type union is 'success' | 'info' | 'warning' only — there is no 'error' variant; default duration 5000 ms, hard cap of 3 toasts (oldest dropped).
Footer 'flex space-x-5' social row has a single child (Mail), so the spacing utility is unused.
Only gray-* neutrals appear in these files (no slate/zinc) — consistent within this slice.
